policy: ADR-0018 and its Amendment B: a Sigma rule becomes actor-specific evidence for a Group only if this review accepts that (rule, Group) pair. The candidate pairs are derived mechanically: an attack.gNNNN tag; a rules-emerging-threats TA/Malware directory named after exactly one active Group (by ATT&CK name or alias) or after software ATT&CK records for exactly one active Group; or an attack.sNNNN tag for such software ('basis'; absent = Group tag). Accepted only when every branch of the rule's detection logic matches a literal artefact published for that Group's own tooling or operation (a name, path, hash, address or payload fragment that unrelated software or another actor would not plausibly produce) and the Group named is supported. A rule that matches a technique, a public tool or framework, commodity malware, an exploit others reuse, or anything generic in even one branch is rejected: a miss is acceptable, a false lead is not.
